ENGLISH: The Persian Empire has collapsed. The Emperor lays dead and without an heir, religious fanatics have taken up arms against the new dynasty and the Assyrians are revolting. The Ilkhanate has been biding its time, awaiting the perfect moment to strike, has the day finally arrived? This is the perfect opportunity to go in, due to the state of civil war we could quickly force all of Persia to recognize our Khan as their new ruler. Alternatively, we could quickly go deal with Afghanistan, to gather strength before we finally attack Persia.

The Persians have been decisively crushed. Tales of our brutality are now spreading across the Orient. Rumors of cavalry running down soldiers, soldiers looting and burning cities and towns, and our mighty Khan sitting atop a throne made out of the skulls of his enemies. The viscious subjugation of Persia has made our Khan infamous, yet few know his name. Those who do know it dare not speak it, worrying that it might summon him. Instead, a nickname has spread like wildfire across the Islamic world...

The Entire Orient has bent its knee to us, we stand unopposed as the rulers of the region. Persia, Afghanistan, Iraq, Armenia, Rum, Cappadocia, Egypt. They have all been crushed by our mighty Khan, proving ourselves to be the only worthy successor to Genghis. We have gone further than any other Khan has ever even dreamt of. The Riches of this land is now ours to collect, for with our brutal and rapid conquest of the region no man would ever dare rise up against our rule. The men in the army have proclaimed Timur the Conqueror to not be a simple Khan, but the Khan of Khans.

Timur the Conqueror has led us to many victories, and it is time for our horde to recognize that. We are not just some temporary horde here to wreak havoc upon the Islamic world, we are here to establish a permanent Empire in this land. From Anatolia to India, all shall bend the knee to Timur the Great, the Scourge of God.

Great conqueror or not, Timur cannot stop the passage of time. New technologies have developed, specifically a new type of weapon called Machine gun, that has made the art of cavalry obsolete. Maneuver warfare has come to an end, static warfare has taken its place. The time has come for us to accept that Khanates cannot exist without the dynamic of the Horde, and thus our Khanate will need to adapt. They say that the stars that shine brightest are the ones that fade out the quickest, while we could not surpass the legacy of Genghis Khan, we can find solace in the fact that with our brief time as a star we shined brighter than any other man ever has.
The Fall of Persia

The Persian Empire has stood as the shield protecting the Islamic world from Mongol attacks since the late 15th century. Their brethren know not all the good the Persians have done for them, but soon they shall find out. After 500 years of being the hegemon of the Orient, they have finally fallen at our hands. Statesmen in Rum and Egypt celebrate the news, seeing it as a sign from their God that it is time for their state to ascend to the status of hegemon, but soon every man, woman and child across the Orient shall cry and pray for a return to how it was.
The Conquest of Messopotamia
The rumors of the riches of Mesopotamia have been spread far and wide, yet the riches have always eluded us. With Persia subjugated the road to Mesopotamia lays open for our armies.
Scale the Mountains of Azerbaijan

Armenia provides an important link between the Islamic world and the lands of the Rus. If we were to take the lands of Azerbaijan we would be able to get access to part of the trade that happens between these civilizations. Azerbaijan's mountainous terrain may prove difficult for our horde to conquer, but accomplishing such a feat will show the strength and skill of our great Khanate and that there is nowhere to hide from our horde.
The Eastern Lands
Afghanistan has long evaded our horde and are turning the nations of India towards the Islamic world. We must crush them to avoid India coming to the aid of the Caliph.
The Subjugation of Armenia

Among the nations of the Orient, none are as old as Armenia. Legend says that their kingdom has existed since the time of the Romans. The conquest of such a fierce and ancient nation will prove that Timur is superior to all those who have come before him, and all those that will come after him.
The Path to the Steppes of the Rus

The Caucasus features many people who have taken inspiration from our ancestor Genghis. It also holds the key to trade with the Rus, controlling this area will be of extreme importance if we wish to be more than a footnote in someone else's history book.
The Riches of Syria

The lands of Syria were given to the Turkic nobles by Persia to rule and govern as a shield against the Greeks. These lands are rich beyond our wildest dreams, and taking it will permanently split the Islamic world from the lands of Anatolia.
Subjugate the Holy Land

The lands of Palestine hold great importance to not only Islam but Christianity and Judaism aswell. Conquering it would be a crowning achievment for our Khan, a decisive victory over Islam, an achievment that not even ten crusades could accomplish. It will force all of Europe and the Orient to recognize us as a power, lest they lose the ability to go on their pilgrimages to their holy city.
Establish our presence in Anatolia
The lands of Anatolia are rich and serve as the primary border between Europe and the Orient. He who controls it has access to Europe and her trade.
The Subjugation of Anatolia
All of Anatolia has been crushed under our hoof. Rum and Cappadocia have been supplanted by us, we have achieved that which the Islamic world took a millenia to do in but a few years.
Greater than Genghis
From Anatolia to India, Jerusalem to Ukraine. All has been subjugated under our mighty Khanate. We have proven ourselves even greater than Genghis.
Proclaim ourselves Emperor

The nations of the Orient and Europe see us as nothing but a horde of ravenous Mongols. We are far greater than any of them could ever even dream of being, yet they treat us as illegitimate. We will proclaims Timur an Emperor, as is befitting a ruler of his greatness, forcing them to come to terms with the fact that we do not intend to leave our new lands.
The People of the East
The promise of riches and eternal glory is sure to convince many of the Pashtun people to accept our rule and join our armies.
The People of Assyria

Iraq has always been a battleground for different Empires fighting for control over the Orient. The promise of a unified Empire dominating the region, and the peace that would follow, is sure to make the Assyrians accept our rule.
The Proud Armenians

The Armenians hail from a proud ancient legacy, having ruled their nation since the time of the Romans. They are unlikely to be tempted by gold or glory, they have plenty already. Thus we will offer them something even better, the possibility of social advancement. Our Empire will not be one dominated by one group, every man will be judged and rewarded based on his work. A strong warrior is a strong warrior, no matter if he is Turkic, Kazak or Armenian.
The Mountain Tribes of Azerbaijan

The Tribes of Azerbaijan have long faced oppression at the hands of Armenia. The promise of a just and equal society will surely entice them. All who pay respect to the Khan will be treated as he would treat any other loyal subjects, no matter their faith or ancestry.
Our Western Cousins

The lands of Syria were given to the Turkic nobles by Persia to rule and govern as a shield against the Greeks. The people living there hail from the Steppes, just as we do. They may have forgotten the ways of the Horse, but it is impossible to forget blood.
The Anatolian People

The lands of Anatolia have been subjugated, and now the time has come to integrate them into our Empire. The lack of an independent Anatolian state has led to a unified Anatolian identity never existing, and thus integrating them will pose us no major challenges.
